quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: Blue signs show information about:
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services like rest areas, food, or hospitals.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign indicates:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of hazards. Round signs warn only of railroad crossings.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond sign warns of danger ahead. Orange diamonds warn of dangers in work areas.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided. You must come to a complete stop and not proceed until the way is clear.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: This symbol is used on:
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle marks slow vehicles like farm equipment or wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop and let pedestrians and traffic pass.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let pedestrians and traffic pass.
questions.explanation: Stop at the marked line. Let other vehicles and pedestrians pass, then proceed safely.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that another road crosses ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to yield or stop.

questions.question: This sign means you:

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on green when it is safe.
Must wait for a solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on green when it is safe.
questions.explanation: "Yield" means slow down and be ready to stop for traffic. After yielding, follow the remaining sign directions.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You may see it where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road winds with curves ahead.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers. This sign warns that wet pavement will be slippery and hard to drive on safely.

questions.question: An orange sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school zone. Stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing without a signal, you should:

options.text: Keep driving while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Never try to beat a train.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down and do not brake.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a full stop then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully; you may not need to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Stop at the marked line and proceed only when safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing.

questions.question: Traffic light colors from top to bottom are:
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged red on top, yellow in the middle, and green on bottom.

questions.question: A five-sided sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to school zones where children may be present.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and routes you cannot enter. You may see it on expressway ramps.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Drive carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Use your turn signal and go at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means wait for traffic to pass. You do not need to stop if no traffic is coming, but always slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Right turns allowed on red lights.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. It is illegal to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Continue at normal speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let trains pass before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A divided highway is starting ahead.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is starting ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a divided highway begins ahead. Stay right of the median divider.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop only if cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers. This sign warns of areas where bicycles may cross.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a traffic signal coming up.

questions.question: This is a:
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right.

questions.question: A pennant-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same way will merge into one lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: If you want to turn left when a red arrow is showing, you should:

options.text: Turn if you yield to other drivers.
Stop and proceed when it is safe.
Stop and stay stopped while the red arrow shows.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and stay stopped while the red arrow shows.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must stop before the intersection and remain stopped. Do not turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped orange signs warn of construction or maintenance hazards.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: This sign indicates:
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means a school zone is nearby. Watch for children and follow speed limits.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks where pedestrians cross. Be alert for people crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. It is illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign indicates:

options.text: A construction or maintenance area ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction or maintenance area ahead.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped orange signs warn of construction hazards ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows:

options.text: The distance from road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal vehicle height in this state.
The maximum vehicle width allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging in. Give drivers space to merge safely.
Traffic is merging in. Keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in. Give drivers space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of merging traffic. Move to another lane if possible to help drivers merge safely.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign shows roadwork is coming. Stay alert for traffic control devices.

questions.question: If you see a flashing red traffic light, you:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat it like a stop sign.
Must wait until it turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light the same as a stop sign. Stop completely, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers. This sign warns of pedestrian crossings. Stop if pedestrians are crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road splits. Bear right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits. Bear right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers. This sign warns the road splits ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers. This sign warns traffic may merge from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert drivers to places where animals, people, and vehicles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals to tell other drivers what they plan to do. A left arm straight out means a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road direction is changing or the road is getting narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only" below it, you should:

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. You must move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns that the number of lanes is reducing and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns of an intersection ahead so you can prepare for turning or other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells drivers to travel only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign directs traffic to stay on the right side of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction sharply.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign tells drivers to slow down and prepare for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: This shape and color sign is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangle signs pointing downward mean you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. Stop at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells drivers that making a U-turn is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may only drive straight ahead.
You are approaching a divided highway.
You may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You may turn left or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow to 35 mph or less for the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow to 35 mph or less for the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. These signs may show a suggested speed for the curve ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed as needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this yellow sign?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are near a school. Stay alert and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharp right then sharp left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharp right then sharp left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show important rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should stay in the right lane to let faster traffic pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right and then curve left. Adjust your speed safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean work zone activity. Stay alert for unexpected conditions. This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Obey the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is an intersection with a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It tells drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: When displayed on the back of a vehicle, this sign means:

options.text: The vehicle is being pulled by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, or farm equipment may display this sign. It warns that the vehicle will only travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only for vehicles in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and check all directions for traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns of a curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that you are leaving a divided road and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts you to a side road crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs always mean a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed carefully. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show important rules you must follow. This sign means no passing is allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane will need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs prohibit actions. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign tells you to be ready for traffic to merge from the right.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign shows a traffic signal. Be ready to respond to the upcoming traffic light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A triangle yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes.
